mapper.sql: id, event_type, endpoint, method, user_email, api_key_id, status_code, duration_ms, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO usage_events (event_type, endpoint, method, user_email, api_key_id, status_code, duration_ms) VALUES (#{eventType}, #{endpoint}, #{method}, #{userEmail}, #{apiKeyId}, #{statusCode}, #{durationMs})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM usage_events ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT endpoint AS endpoint, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM usage_events WHERE endpoint IS NOT NULL GROUP BY endpoint ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT method AS method, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM usage_events WHERE method IS NOT NULL GROUP BY method ORDER BY cnt DESC
SELECT CAST(status_code AS TEXT) AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM usage_events WHERE status_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY status_code ORDER BY status
SELECT substr(created_at, 1, 10) AS date, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM usage_events WHERE created_at >= date('now', '-' || #{days} || ' days') GROUP BY substr(created_at, 1, 10) ORDER BY date DESC
